comparison_note: Different geometry establishes a revision difference, not chronology by timestamp alone. This is a fresh snapshot of the user-selected source. STEP volume/area/topology and known source roles were compared with the prior canonical files.
stock_body_note: Stock front cover and middle body source exports are retained as source parts; the installed assemblies use the one-piece curved community cover instead.

counts.count_basis: Canonical STEP models; native companion files are listed with their corresponding canonical records.

curved_front.author: Lucy Chapar
curved_front.replacement: Replaces body-cover and body-middle; omit their two joining M3 bolts and side-loaded nuts.

placement.relative_to_stock_body_cover: identity; matching front plane and lower cover mounting axes
placement.warning: Raw stock body-middle STEP uses a different print orientation; do not identify final assembly transform from its raw bbox alone.

fresh_assembly_replacement.explanation: The omitted screws and nuts are coaxial with upper cover mounting holes at cover-localXY(+/-35,19.8000003). The retained lower screws/nuts are coaxial with cover-localXY(+/-25,-60.1999997).

source_registration.registration_method: Match new Upper unique r40.120038mm collar axis plus unique r7.65mm hinge counterbore axis and axial plane. Ring clock from old nominal source is intentionally not imposed.

one_piece_upper.label: Upper
one_piece_upper.note: Source Upper is one connected CAD solid. Source Handle remains a separate overcenter latch.

assembly_integration.source_geometry_changes: Motor, carriage and belt source solids repackaged without geometry edits. The integrated lower has an editable 6 mm hinge passage and matching M6 head/nut seats. A generated ISO 4762 M6 x 25 screw replaces source M6 x 20; the M6 nut moves outward 1 mm. Original export filenames and hashes remain recorded.
assembly_integration.contact_note: Source closed-clamp and lower/adapter contacts remain open fit checks. The revised M6 head bears on the pivoting upper jaw, guided radially by the lower counterbore, with no volumetric screw interference. Approximately 0.000063 mm3 at the nut floor is sub-micron source-coordinate roundoff. Physical fit and loaded testing are pending.

hinge_revision.design_intent: The ordinary M6 bolt head seats against the pivoting arm; the lower counterbore locates and braces its head.

clamp_variant_note: The source upper and integrated enclosure lower now use a 6 mm hinge passage. The earlier Mini/BOM component files remain unchanged; original raw Onshape hardware exports remain in the source inventory, with the installed M6 x 25 override recorded here.
